entries.0a92ed93f06c79a6: It operates the Tokaido Shinkansen between Tokyo and Shin-Osaka. In the railway business results of the company (the reporting company) for the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating distance was 552.6 km; passengers carried were 183,924 thousand (commuter 13,947 thousand; non-commuter 169,977 thousand); passenger-kilometers were 60,860 million, up 10.2% year on year; and passenger transport revenue was ¥1,479,380 million (commuter ¥16,174 million; non-commuter ¥1,463,205 million), up 11.1% year on year. The seat occupancy rate was 67.9%. Non-commuter revenue accounts for nearly 99% of the total, a structure supported by business and travel demand. Considering that more than 60 years have passed since its opening, the company is advancing earthquake countermeasures covering the entire line, including derailment and deviation prevention measures, and large-scale renovation work to maintain the soundness of civil engineering structures. It began services in premium class seats (private compartment type) and is preparing to introduce semi-private compartment type seats within fiscal 2027.
entries.140dcf12529a947d: This is the category undertaken by JR Tokai Bus Co., Ltd. It was established in March 1988, and in April of the same year the company's motor vehicle transportation business was transferred to it by business transfer. The company states that it set product offerings that capture customer needs while giving top priority to ensuring safety.
entries.149899deaac593fb: This category engages in the hotel business along the Company's railway lines and elsewhere, the travel business, the advertising business, etc., and also manufactures railway rolling stock and performs maintenance, inspection and repair of various facilities, etc.; the company notes it as a business segment not included in reportable segments. The hotel and services business is handled by JR Tokai Hotels Co., Ltd., JR Tokai Tours Co., Ltd. and JR Tokai Agency Co., Ltd.; other companies included are Nippon Sharyo, Ltd., JR Tokai Construction Co., Ltd., Nihon Kikai Hosen Co., Ltd., JR Tokai Techno Create Co., Ltd. and Shinsei Technos Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥134,543 million, exceeding that of the real estate business; however, because it is not a reportable segment, it is shown here. Segment profit (operating profit) was ¥24,460 million, up 57.0% from the previous fiscal year, the largest rate of increase; the number of employees was 6,691, segment assets were ¥593,071 million, and capital expenditure was ¥8.2 billion. The company states that in the hotel business it opened 'Courtyard by Marriott Kyoto Shijo Karasuma', and in the railway rolling stock manufacturing business it worked to secure orders for and manufacture railway rolling stock, construction machinery and other equipment.
entries.26ae620d40306d63: A railway company that operates the Tokaido Shinkansen and conventional lines in the Tokai region, also operates the department store and station building at Nagoya Station, and is constructing the Chuo Shinkansen using superconducting maglev.
entries.2b358da5dfb3d345: It operates the conventional line network in the Tokai region. In the operating results of the company's (filing company's) railway business, operating distance for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,418.2km, 2.6 times that of the Shinkansen, but passenger transport revenue was ¥106,000 million (commuter passes ¥32,433 million, non-commuter ¥73,566 million), about 7% of the Shinkansen. The number of passengers carried was 395,252 thousand, more than 2 times that of the Shinkansen, while passenger-kilometers were 8,864 million (up 2.6% from the previous fiscal year) and the load factor was 30.9%, a pattern in which many people ride short distances. On the limited express "Shinano", "Hida" and "Nanki", it flexibly adds cars and runs extra services according to demand, and began all-reserved-seat operation during the year-end and New Year period, when use is concentrated. It is advancing the expansion of the TOICA area and the start of a mobile IC service, the start of a ticketless boarding service for "Hida", and the introduction of QR code payment between Tenryukyo Station and Miyagi Station on the Iida Line, among others.

entries.335fa0e6d2bc8f75: This category leases the JR Central Towers and JR Gate Tower at Nagoya Station, and station buildings and station commercial facilities such as those at Tokyo, Shin-Yokohama and Kyoto stations. JR Central Building Co., Ltd., Shin-Yokohama Station Development Co., Ltd., Tokyo Station Development Co., Ltd., Nagoya Station Development Co., Ltd., and JR Tokai Kansai Development Co., Ltd. are in charge of it. The company states that it operated the JR Central Towers and JR Gate Tower as an integrated whole to expand revenue.

entries.49d77a93a670cb96: This is a reportable segment that operates a department store at JR Central Towers and sells goods in station premises and other locations. It is undertaken by JR Tokai Takashimaya Co., Ltd., JR Tokai Retailing Plus Co., Ltd., and JR Tokai Trading Co., Ltd. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥174,477 million, the second-largest reportable segment after the transportation business; however, segment profit (operating profit) was ¥15,822 million, the smallest of the three reportable segments, indicating a business structure in which profit is thin relative to sales. Employees numbered 2,937, with temporary employees of 5,713 (not included in that figure and the largest of the four categories); segment assets were ¥181,609 million, and capital expenditure was ¥8.3 billion. The company states that it held a 25th anniversary campaign at JR Nagoya Takashimaya and expanded and renewed its Japanese and Western liquor sections, opening “Wine Maison,” a liquor section with one of the largest selections in Japan.

entries.97f6d9a4f90ff266: A reportable segment that operates the railway business on the Tokaido Shinkansen and conventional lines in the Tokai region, as well as the bus business and others. The company's railway business has operating distances of 552.6km for the Shinkansen and 1,418.2km for conventional lines, a total of 1,970.8km. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,641,663 million, accounting for 8 tenths of consolidated operating revenue, and segment profit (operating income) was ¥767,472 million, a scale that covers almost all of consolidated operating income. Segment assets were ¥10,003,296 million, the number of employees was 19,273, and capital expenditures were ¥571.0 billion for the company and ¥0.5 billion for consolidated subsidiaries. Regarding the Tokaido Shinkansen, the company explains that it completed transport for the Japan International Exposition 2025 (Osaka-Kansai Expo) and, in addition to the "Nozomi 12-train timetable", made use of a timetable that, since the March timetable revision, runs up to 13 "Nozomi" trains per hour in some time slots. It is advancing earthquake countermeasures, including the installation of derailment prevention guards along the entire line, and large-scale renovation work, and continues to introduce the N700S. On conventional lines, it completed the introduction of the 315 series commuter trains across all cars, and began one-man operation with 4-car 315 series trains equipped with a safety confirmation support device using cameras on the sides of the cars and image recognition technology. The main affiliated companies are the company and JR Tokai Bus Co., Ltd.

entries.a28ee77aa244aeda: This category sells real estate and is in charge of it: JR Tokai Real Estate Co., Ltd. The company was established in March 2001 as Jeiāru Tōkai Fudōsan Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JR Tokai Real Estate Co., Ltd. in July 2025. The company states that it promoted the effective use of group-owned land, such as former company housing sites.

entries.b3a14378133c262d: This category operates “JR Nagoya Takashimaya” inside JR Central Towers at Nagoya Station and “Takashimaya Gate Tower Mall” inside JR Gate Tower, and is undertaken by JR Tokai Takashimaya Co., Ltd. JR Nagoya Takashimaya opened in March 2000, and Takashimaya Gate Tower Mall opened in April 2017. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, there were the 25th anniversary campaign for JR Nagoya Takashimaya and the opening of the liquor section “Wine Maison.”
entries.bbf67be86bb5e17c: This reportable segment engages in the real estate rental business for station buildings and other properties, as well as the real estate sales business. The company, JR Central Building Co., Ltd., JR Tokai Real Estate Co., Ltd., Shin-Yokohama Station Development Co., Ltd., Tokyo Station Development Co., Ltd., Nagoya Station Development Co., Ltd., and JR Tokai Kansai Development Co., Ltd. are in charge of this segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥55,534 million, the smallest of the reportable segments. Most lessees are within the group, so intersegment revenue was ¥40,173 million; including this, total revenue was ¥95,707 million (up 10.4% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥25,279 million, exceeding that of the distribution business. The number of employees was 668, segment assets were ¥420,776 million, and capital expenditure was ¥20.7 billion. The company states that it advanced the expansion and renewal of station commercial facilities at Tokyo, Hamamatsu, Nagoya and Kyoto stations, among others, and the development of areas under elevated tracks near Nagoya Station and elsewhere; the effective use of group-owned land, such as former company housing sites; and the expansion of the workspace 'EXPRESS WORK' within station premises and in buildings directly connected to stations.
